//audit_2026_05_13_h_ops_2: Pin Vite >=5.4.21 + esbuild >=0.25.0 to close CVE-2024-23331 (Vite <=5.0.11 dev server path traversal via ?import + @fs), CVE-2024-31207 (Vite dev server.fs.deny bypass on Windows), CVE-2024-45811 (Vite import.meta.glob arbitrary file read), and GHSA-x574-m823-4x7w (esbuild 0.19.x dev server CORS misconfig). Ponder 0.8.33 transitively pins vite 5.0.7 + esbuild 0.19.12 — these overrides force the patched 5.x versions without bumping ponder itself. NOTE 2026-05-14: GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9 (Vite <=6.4.1 Path Traversal in Optimized Deps .map Handling, moderate severity) is NOT addressed — fix would require vite ^6.4.2 but vite 6 breaks ponder's `vite-tsconfig-paths@4.3.1` (cannot resolve `import 'vite'`, hard-crashes `ponder --version` / `ponder dev` / `ponder start`). Accept-risk justification: GHSA-4w7w affects the DEV SERVER's `.map` file handler only; production indexer uses `ponder start` (no dev server exposed). Re-evaluate when ponder ships vite-tsconfig-paths >=5 compatible with vite 6.
